BLINK desktop video processing components

FFmpeg 8.1.2, JavaCPP preset 1.5.14, unmodified LGPL native package.
The executable reports LGPL version 3 or later (--enable-version3).
FFmpeg-LGPL-3.0.txt and its incorporated GPL-3.0.txt terms accompany it;
FFmpeg-LGPL-2.1.txt also covers upstream files offered under that license.
JavaCPP and preset Java bindings: Apache License 2.0 / GPLv2 with Classpath exception.
OpenH264: BSD license, copyright Cisco Systems.

The corresponding upstream sources and reproducible native build recipes are:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n8.1.2
https://github.com/bytedeco/javacpp-presets/tree/1.5.14/ffmpeg
https://github.com/bytedeco/javacpp/tree/1.5.14
https://github.com/cisco/openh264

License texts accompany this notice. The LGPL build is used, not the optional
GPL-only FFmpeg artifact. Video processing runs in a separate executable using
the packaged native libraries. These components can be rebuilt/replaced using
the upstream sources and JavaCPP build recipes; BLINK does not restrict their
modification or debugging. No music files or music licensing rights are bundled.

Keep these notices and corresponding source/build links with redistributed
installers. Source and binary versions must remain matched when updating them.
